# ExxonMobil Chemical

> ExxonMobil Chemical is a worldwide chemicals and specialties company offering signature polymers, adhesives, and industrial solutions across agriculture, automotive, healthcare, and energy sectors.

ExxonMobil Chemical provides a comprehensive portfolio of chemical products and solutions backed by decades of technology innovation, quality management systems (GPQMS, ISO 9001, GMP), and sustainability initiatives including recycled polymers through Exxtend.

## Key Topics

- Vistamaxx
- Exceed
- Exact
- Isopar
- Escorez
- Exxtend
- polypropylene
- polymers
- adhesives and sealants
- GPQMS
- ISO 9001
- sustainability
- ISCC PLUS certification
- specialty chemicals
- industrial applications

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Adhesives and Sealants](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/products/product-clusters/adhesives-and-sealants): Adhesives portfolio including Escorez and Exxal pressure-sensitive adhesives.
- [ExxonMobil Chemical Homepage](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en): ExxonMobil Chemical homepage showcasing Vistamaxx, Isopar, and signature polymers.

## Industry Solutions

- [Solutions by Industry](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries): Industry solutions directory for agriculture, automotive, energy, and healthcare.
- [Agricultural Films](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries/agriculture): Agricultural films using signature polymers for crop protection applications.
- [Advanced Materials in Automotive Engineering](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries/automotive): Automotive materials including Exceed, Exact, and battery recycling solutions.
- [Construction and Building Materials](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries/building-and-construction): Construction materials with Vistamaxx, Exceed, and specialty chemicals.
- [Healthcare Solutions](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries/healthcare-and-medical): Healthcare polymers with Vistamaxx, Exact, and Exceed for medical applications.
- [Hygiene & Personal Care Polymers](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries/hygiene-and-personal-care): Hygiene products with Exceed, Vistamaxx, and Escorez adhesives.
- [Industrial Applications](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries/industrial-applications): Industrial chemicals including Exxsol D, Isopar, and Actrel products.
- [Energy Solutions](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries/energy): Energy solutions with Escaid, Univolt, and lithium-ion battery recycling.
- [Polyolefin Blends](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries/compounding): Polyolefin blends using Vistamaxx and Exact for packaging applications.
- [Consumer Products](https://www.exxonmobilchemical.com/en/industries/consumer-products): Consumer products including combustion fluids and Vistamaxx polymers.
